Bill.BriefDescription: Defining "principal residence" for the purpose of relocation of a child.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the relocation of a child in a domesticrelations matter; and amending RCW 26.09.410.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 26.09.410 and 2000 c 21 s 2 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The definitions in this section apply throughout RCW 26.09.405through 26.09.560 and 26.09.260 unless the context clearly requiresotherwise. (1) "Court order" means a temporary or permanent parenting plan,custody order, visitation order, or other order governing the residenceof a child under this title. (2) "Principal residence" means any residence where the childspends a significant number of school nights, including thoseresidences shared equally by the child. "Principal residence" does notinclude residences where the child may spend every other weekend,holidays, or summer vacations. (3) "Relocate" means a change in principal residence either p. 1 SB 5453permanently or for a protracted period of time.
